q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Short answer
- Net sales are down: average net sales per day fell from ₹92,230 to ₹66,698 (−27.7%) in this week so far vs last week. The likely contributors are a simultaneous drop in ad spend (−27.8% per day) and fewer orders (−26.7% per day); the diagnostic run did not find a single proved cause — ad spend is correlated and a plausible contributor, but the causal test returned insufficient evidence to call it the definitive cause.

Key evidence (previous → this week so far; period note below)
- Net sales (per-day): ₹92,230 → ₹66,698 (−27.7%) — Derived (aggregation of daily totals from the commerce view and compared).  
- Orders (per-day): 48.4 → 35.5 (−26.7%) — Measured (diagnose output / query rows).  
- Ad spend (per-day): ₹61,534 → ₹44,424 (−27.8%) — Measured (paid_media).  
- Avg order value (incl. tax, per-day): ₹112,269 → ₹84,166 (−25%) — Measured (diagnose summary).  
- Return revenue (per-day): ₹7,623 → ₹0 (−100%) — Measured (diagnose summary).  
- P&L net profit (per-day): −₹16,260 → −₹62,870 (more negative) — Derived (pnl view totals).

What the diagnostic engine found (labels kept)
- No single supported_cause identified. Orders and AOV dropped and together explain most of the sales decline (these are proximate drivers — measured/descriptive).  
- Ad spend dropped in step with sales and is classified as correlation / likely_contributor (same-day association but not proven as the causal driver).  
- Other checks (sessions, add-to-carts, impressions) moved with sales but did not pass causal tests — insufficient_evidence to call them causes.
